item.title: ❗️ Throughout the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes
item.description: ❗️ Throughout the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against Ukrainian ports as well as vessels used in support of the AFU. 🔥 As a result of the strikes, a dry cargo ship carrying military cargo was hit in the port of Chernomorsk, Odessa region. 💥 Moreover, a dry cargo ship carrying military equipment to the port of Izmail to support the Ukrainian Armed Forces was hit at sea. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🚫 What a twist Drones of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces neutralised an ATV with AFU personnel
item.description: 🚫 What a twist Drones of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces neutralised an ATV with AFU personnel close to Slavyansk. The driver spotted a Russian drone, lost control, and tumbled into a ditch along with the ATV and the passenger. The rotation is disrupted. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫️ Enemy falls back under our pressure The CO of an anti-aircraft missile battery from the Yuzhnaya Group's 1465th Motorised Rifle Regiment with the call sign 'Pamir'
item.description: ▫️ Enemy falls back under our pressure 💬 The CO of an anti-aircraft missile battery from the Yuzhnaya Group's 1465th Motorised Rifle Regiment with the call sign 'Pamir' told about operations of units in settlements of Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration. 'Our drones fly in Druzhkovka, Alekseyevo-Druzhkovka. Now, there are less R18 drones over Konstantinovka. It means our AD units progress, operate. We're moving forward. Their UAV command posts pull back. The range no longer allows them to deploy drones and deliver any kind of logistics.' 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
Manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades have been hit near Lidino, Andreyevka, Belozerskoye, Dobropolye, Novovodyanoye, Gulevo, Novogrigorovka, and Sergeyevka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 400 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and 12 motor vehicles.
🚩
The Vostok Group of Forces advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence and liberated Rozovka in Zaporozhye region.
💥
Strikes were delivered
at manpower and hardware of two air assault brigades, an assault brigade, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a marine brigade close to the Velikomikhaylovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Novovladimirovka, Tavriyskoye, Obshcheye, Vasilkovoye, Omelnik, Samoylovka, Svetlaya Dolina, and Barvinovka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU lost more than 240 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and 11 motor vehicles.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line

▪️
Up to 30 troops, nine motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station were neutralised.

item.title: 📍 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 📍 Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue to tighten the encirclement and expand the external control zone. 🚩 As a result of resolute actions, Russian troops took control over Malaya Volchya in Kharkov region. 💥 Strikes were delivered at enemy manpower close to Khripuny and Buzovo (Kharkov region). item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29457

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region
continue to tighten the encirclement and expand the external control zone.
🚩
As a result of resolute actions, Russian troops took control over Malaya Volchya in Kharkov region.
💥
Strikes were delivered
at enemy manpower close to Khripuny and Buzovo (Kharkov region). All attempts of the AFU units to break through from the encirclement have been thwarted.
▪️
Over the past 24 hours, up to 40 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and one self-propelled artillery system have been neutralised.
📊
Since the beginning of the month, more than 650 militants, 16 armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, 13 ATVs, and 25 UGVs have been neutralised.
💥
During the external control perimeter expansion, enemy groups
attempting to break through the fortifications
were eliminated
near Prikolotnoye, and Novoaleksandrovka (Kharkov region).
🔥
In addition, in Kharkov region,
strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of a heavy mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade, a mechanised brigade, and an assault regiment of the AFU near Zolochev, Dementiyevka, Revoliutsionnoye, Grachevka, Bratenitsa, and Liptsy (Kharkov region).
📍
In Sumy region
, clusters of manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and two territorial defence brigades have been hit near Grunovka, Kucherovka, Boyaro-Lezhachi, and Khothen (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, the enemy lost up to 220 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, five motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line
. Formations of three mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade have been hit near Nizhneye Solenoye, Chervony Oskol, Izyum, Putnikovo, Nechvolodovka (Kharkov region), Krymki, Raygorodok, and Mayaki (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to over 200 troops, one U.S.-made HMMWV armoured vehicle, seven motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions
. Manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade, a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade have been hit near Krasny Molochar, Druzhkovka, Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Vasilyevskaya Pustosh, Nikolayevka, and Kondratovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 170 troops, one U.S.-made MaxxPro armoured vehicle, and 14 motor vehicles.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
